item.title: TRAGIC INCIDENT: Fatality confirmed at train station near Hemel Hempstead
item.description: Emergency services were called to Apsley station yesterday (Thursday, January 15) at around 7.45pm following reports of a casualty on the tracks. item.description: Firefighters were called today (Friday, January 16) to a lorry fire on the westbound M25 between Junctions 25 and 24 with the lorry fully alight.
